summary: Luke Badiali ran a marketing session with Simon Clarke and Priya Natarajan to support the deal-to-value positioning. Harcourt publishes very little and the partners are not visible to deal teams outside existing relationships. We agreed a quarterly tech risk index and a Priya-led content programme aimed at deal partners.

discussion.keyPoints: Priya said deal partners at funds without a panel place have rarely heard of Harcourt. Simon has written two articles in the last year, both on IT strategy for corporates.
Harcourt has findings from over 120 DD engagements. Luke suggested an anonymised index of common tech risks by sector.
Confidentiality limits named case studies. Simon thinks one portfolio CEO might agree to a named 100-day plan story.

recommendations.recommendation: Publish a quarterly Harcourt Tech Risk Index from anonymised data across 120 DD engagements, first issue in Q1.
Make Priya the public face to PE audiences, with one LinkedIn post a week on recent deal tech themes.
Secure one named 100-day plan case study from a portfolio CEO.
Measure the Tech Risk Index by new deal partner meetings, targeting 10 per issue.
Run a podcast series with portfolio CTOs.

actions.action: Pull anonymised risk data for the first Tech Risk Index

nextFocus: Develop partnerships with firms around the deal, such as financial DD and legal.
nextPreparation: Priya to list advisers Harcourt regularly works alongside on deals.

tests.question: What did we agree about the Tech Risk Index?
Is the named 100-day plan case study agreed?
Who is the public face to PE audiences?
